Name: Simple Town Chatter
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#D8B4FE]💬 Simple Town Chatter[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]A little more life between conversations.[/center]

[center]Nearby villagers share short overhead remarks, greet you and occasionally reply to each other while you explore. Written for the 34 vanilla friendship villagers, using Stardew Valley’s loaded speech-bubble artwork.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]🌿 Everyday Life[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53536/53536-1791347860-1298332909.png[/img]

[center]Hear personal observations, seasonal thoughts, weather and location remarks, and greetings that use actual character names. Nearby villagers can exchange a greeting and a reply; the reply appears after the first bubble fades.[/center]

[center]The writing is a finite, context-based collection, rather than live AI-generated dialogue. Recent lines are remembered to reduce repetition. This is a standalone mod; Simple Dynamic Dialogue(WIP) is not required.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]🎚 Choose Your Chatter[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53536/53536-1791347868-1867701038.png[/img]

[center]These are opportunity intervals, not guaranteed speech every few seconds. Visibility, distance, cooldowns, settings and scene safety still apply. Frequent can greet you when you approach within three tiles; standing beside someone does not repeatedly trigger greetings.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]🎪 Festival Moments[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Festival chatter is enabled by default and has its own switch. Villagers speak only when actually present and safely available for free roaming.[/center]

[center][quote][b]Traditional festivals[/b]
Egg Festival • Flower Dance • Luau • Dance of the Moonlight Jellies
Stardew Valley Fair • Spirit’s Eve • Festival of Ice • Feast of the Winter Star

[b]Other supported events[/b]
Desert Festival • Night Market • Trout Derby • SquidFest[/quote][/center]

[center]Ceremonies, contests and scripted scenes keep priority. Unsupported festival days stay silent.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]🛡 Fits Around Your Game[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53536/53536-1791347902-812860489.png[/img]
[center]Native speech and dialogue take priority. Added chatter stops during menus, cutscenes, ceremonies and other busy moments, and while the game is out of focus. Interrupted bubbles and replies are discarded, so they do not build up for later.[/center]

[center]No extra friendship, items or rewards. Villager schedules, movement, facing and ordinary conversations stay intact. The mod uses loaded fonts and bubble artwork and does not replace NPC portraits, sprites or dialogue assets.[/center]

[center]In multiplayer, each player needs their own copy to see local chatter. Added bubbles are not broadcast to other players. Split-screen viewports have separate chatter state; full multiplayer and split-screen playtesting remains pending.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]⚙ Settings & Languages[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][quote][b]Optional Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]
Choose frequency; toggle farmer greetings, villager greetings, replies, personal, seasonal, weather, location and festival remarks; exclude selected villagers.

[b]Without GMCM[/b]
Use the generated config.json for the same options. No new hotkey or HUD button.

[b]All 12 game languages[/b]
English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Turkish and Hungarian.[/quote][/center]

[center]Translations are machine-assisted with editorial repairs; fluent community corrections are welcome.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]📦 Installation & Updates[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53536/53536-1791347912-2123130831.png[/img]

[center]When updating older Normal settings to 1.3, Frequent is adopted once. Off and Quiet are retained, and you can select Normal again afterward.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]🤝 Expansion Companions[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]The base download covers vanilla friendship villagers. The separate Simple Town Chatter (SVE) companion adds 15 regular Stardew Valley Expanded villagers and requires the base mod plus SVE 1.15.11 or later. Its 840 additional original entries share the same one-bubble scheduler and safety checks. Install the companion separately if you want its coverage.[/center]

[center]Stardew Valley Expanded belongs to FlashShifter and its contributors. The companion is an independent addition and does not bundle original SVE dialogue or artwork.[/center]
